765.title: The menu designer screen: build, preview, save and manage designs by hand
humanItems: The look: on a desktop the controls and the sample menu sit side by side and the sample changes as you type

the form's page · change one field, then follow a link out of the page · a question asks whether to leave or stay — here: in the designer change a color, then press the menu library link in the header: «לצאת בלי לשמור?» appears and «הישאר» keeps the change.

the page with the delete button · press delete, then cancel · a confirmation appears and nothing is removed — here: a design's row menu «מחיקה», then «ביטול»: the design stays; with «אישור» it leaves the list (and Trash lists it).
the list's page with no items · open the page · a message says the list is empty — here: «עיצובי תפריט» of a business with no designs says «עוד אין עיצובים לתפריט» with «עיצוב חדש».

the screen's page with the data request failing · open the page · a readable error with a retry appears, not a blank page — here: with the server stopped, «עיצובי תפריט» shows «לא הצלחנו לטעון את העיצובים» and «נסו שוב».
any list page on a phone and on a desktop · look at the rows · the page header matches the other list pages and every row stays on one line — here: «עיצובי תפריט» next to «ספריית תפריטים».

any list page with row actions · look at a row's edit and remove actions · they are the pencil and trash icon buttons used on the products list, with no text buttons — here: a design row's edit and delete.
a dialog with an explained control · hover the control · its explanation shows as a tooltip and no explanation text sits on the modal — here: the base-template popup's four choices.
On a phone the editor shows the sample menu above the controls and every control is reachable by scrolling the page.

decisions.text: behaviour: the «עיצובי תפריט» button sits in the page header's leading slot, because a second header action is drawn under «תפריט חדש» — reverse: move it to header-actions once the shared header lays actions side by side

behaviour: the leave question is the shared guard's, with «ביטול» / «יציאה בלי לשמור», not «לצאת בלי לשמור?» / «הישאר» as the [human] item words it — reverse: give the page its own confirmLeave() and the confirm popup a cancel label
behaviour: on a phone a design card hides the title font's name so the row stays on one line — reverse: remove the phone rule of .design-card__font
behaviour: rename, copy and set-default are icon buttons with tooltips beside the pencil and trash — reverse: give them text in the card's row menu

behaviour: staff see edit, rename and delete only on their own designs; opening another's design by address shows the editor and the server refuses the save — reverse: gate the save button with PermissionService
behaviour: an unknown design address shows «העיצוב לא נמצא» with a back button — reverse: redirect to the list
behaviour: an uploaded picture over 300KB is re-encoded as JPEG, so a transparent logo gets a white background — reverse: upload logos without shrinking
behaviour: copy, rename and set-default answer «העיצוב נשמר», delete answers «העיצוב נמחק» — reverse: drop the messages
behaviour: a long name is shortened so « (עותק)» still fits in 60 characters, and a longer rename is cut at 60 — reverse: cut the whole copied name, or show a field error
behaviour: a background upload that finishes after another background kind was picked keeps the picture but not the image kind — reverse: switch to image when the upload ends
behaviour: the editor puts the cursor in the name field when it opens, as the form recipe says — reverse: remove the focus call in menu-design-edit.page.ts
